description: Properly using ML for insurance risk prediction.
goalDescription: I want to build a model that predicts insurance pricing and risk based on historical claims.
planSummary: Use machine learning on structured claims data to predict risk scores and prices.

description: User confuses generative AI with predictive modeling.
goalDescription: I want to generate synthetic risk scores for each client using generative AI instead of classic machine learning.
planSummary: Use a text generator or image generator to create risk scores and then use that as pricing.

description: User mixes computer vision and NLP incorrectly.
goalDescription: I want to use an NLP model to read images of damaged cars and classify the damage level.
planSummary: Feed car crash photos into a language model and ask it to describe the damage.

description: Plain NLP / LLM use – no issue.
goalDescription: I want a chatbot that explains our insurance products to clients in natural language.
planSummary: Use an LLM fine-tuned or prompted with our product documentation.

description: Recommendation system correctly framed as ML.
goalDescription: Like YouTube, I want to recommend videos based on what users watched before.
planSummary: Train a collaborative filtering or ML model using watch history.

description: Using LLM for structured data prediction when ML is better.
goalDescription: I want to predict customer churn using our database of customer records.
planSummary: Use ChatGPT to analyze the CSV file and predict which customers will leave.

description: Correctly using Computer Vision for image tasks.
goalDescription: I need to detect faces in photos for our security system.
planSummary: Use a computer vision model with face detection capabilities.

description: Using deep learning for a simple rule-based task.
goalDescription: I want a simple if-then rule system to approve or deny loan applications.
planSummary: Build a deep neural network with multiple layers to learn the approval rules.
